cost_strategies.currency_note: Priced with database storage at USD 0.1095/GB-month and object storage at USD 0.023/GB-month (reference list prices, not the owner's invoice: Huawei Cloud RDS for MySQL cloud SSD AF-Johannesburg 0.00015 USD/GB-hour x 730 h; OBS Standard 0.023 USD/GB-month); overlaps between strategies are possible, so the total is an upper bound.

items.title: Move buckets not written for over a year to archive-class storage
items.action: Apply a lifecycle rule (Standard → Archive/Cold) on buckets whose last object write is older than a year; keep listing metadata hot.

items.risk: Last write is the newest object timestamp in the listing; read frequency was not measured, and archive-class retrieval carries its own fee.
items.saving_basis: upper bound at the full Standard tariff (set ESTATE_ARCHIVE_STORAGE_COST_PER_GB_MONTH for the tiering delta)

items.title: Reconcile duplicate objects across OBS buckets
items.action: Confirm ETag+size candidates by object hash, keep one copy per bucket and replace the rest with references or lifecycle-delete them.
items.risk: Candidates share ETag and size, which for multipart uploads is not a content hash; bytes are candidates × mean object size, an estimate. Confirm before deleting.

items.title: Move tables not written for over a year to cold storage
items.action: Export to compressed object storage, keep a schema stub and a pointer; restore on demand.
items.risk: Staleness is read from the latest timestamp column; tables without timestamps are not counted as stale.

items.title: Remove redundant (prefix-covered) indexes
items.action: Drop each non-unique index whose columns are a leading prefix of another index on the same table.
items.risk: Write amplification falls immediately; verify no query hints name the dropped index.

items.title: De-duplicate exact repeated rows inside tables
items.action: Add uniqueness constraints or a merge step at ingestion; archive the historical duplicates.
items.risk: Duplicates measured on complete passes or stratified samples; the primary key was excluded from the comparison.

items.title: Consolidate duplicate and staging copies of the same tables
items.action: Retire or snapshot-then-drop the smaller copy of each same-schema pair with measured content overlap; keep one system of record.
items.risk: Copies may be deliberate (staging, backups). Confirm ownership before retirement; the sketch overlap is an estimate, not a row-level diff.

items.title: Drop or archive empty tables
items.action: Remove empty tables and their indexes after a 30-day observation window.
items.risk: Empty by TABLE_ROWS estimate; a freshly truncated live table looks the same.

items.title: Repair or purge orphaned references
items.action: Reconcile foreign-key candidates whose sampled values are missing in the target table; purge rows that reference nothing.
items.risk: Targets were inferred from column names (x_id → x/xs); a missing target may be a naming convention, not a break.

items.title: Minimise PII-dense tables that no product needs
items.action: Tokenise or drop personal columns in analytics copies; keep raw identifiers only in the system of record.
items.risk: Detector is deterministic and sampled; absence of a marker is not absence of personal data.

obs.method: External S3-compatible ListObjectsV2, all returned pages, 16 bounded concurrent bucket listings; continuation tokens and page sums are checkpointed on the worker so successive bounded runs resume; ETag+size candidates are not proven byte duplicates; no object bodies read
obs.duplication_note: Duplicate candidates are objects whose ETag+size fingerprint was already seen in the same store; duplicate bytes = candidates × mean object size of the bucket (estimate). Not proven byte duplicates.

nas.method: External read-only directory/stat enumeration on the admitted mount, 2 bounded concurrent walkers over a shared queue; directories are committed only when fully scanned and the frontier is checkpointed on the worker so successive bounded runs resume until the share is complete; path-hash-pinned sample of up to three media per channel, ffprobe; duration covers inspected sample only
nas.duplication_note: This enumeration recorded no content fingerprints (stat/listing only), so duplication is unmeasured; sizes and dates were read, bodies were not.

degradation.kinds_note: Row-weighted share of measured rows whose worst column shows the kind; a row can carry several kinds.
degradation.dead_columns_note: Columns never populated (null on ≥99.9 % of measured rows, primary key excluded): schema carried without data.
degradation.trend_note: No previous verified census to compare against; trend starts with the next census.
